# Source health

An unreadable source is not a quiet source. Follow these five rules on every sweep.

1. If a search or fetch returns 401, 402, 403, 429, a block or a refusal, record it as source unreachable with the source name and the error.
2. Never treat an unreadable source as a quiet one. A sweep that files nothing is only a good sweep if every source was readable.
3. If any source was unreachable, post the summary comment anyway and start it with SOURCE UNREACHABLE: source, error, lanes affected.
4. Do not retry a blocked source more than once.
5. Some sites cannot be read at all. Say so in the comment rather than skipping them silently.

A run where every source was unreachable is a failed run. Say so. Do not summarise it as quiet.
